thesis: GMAB is a profitable, high-margin oncology royalty and pipeline name whose late-October re-rating looks fundamental, and it is now digesting that gap in a controlled pullback toward the 10-day low while the SMA50 and SMA200 keep rising. Entry sits near support and the technical card's reward/risk is attractive on paper, with the target set at prior closes below the 52-week high. The setup is not clean. The stop is tight (about 0.7 ATR), the regime is risk-off, and growth and valuation are unverified, so this is a moderate-conviction, small-size swing long at best. Defensive healthcare relative strength is the main macro support.
